# Task list alignment

A plain bullet list is the alignment reference for the task lists below.

- Plain bullet item (first level)

## Tight task list

- [ ] Tight task item: the label must sit on the list text edge
- [x] Tight checked item

## Loose task list

- [ ] Loose task item: its paragraph must sit on the list text edge

- [x] Loose checked item

## Nested list (mixed bullet + task)

- Plain parent bullet item
  - Nested plain bullet item
- [ ] Task parent item
  - [ ] Nested task item
